recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a sepia-toned rectangular photograph of two men in 80s fashion, inset into a larger dark green marble texture background, accented by vibrant geometric patterns and tilted condensed typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Inset sepia photo against a full-bleed dark marble background
Tilted vertical text aligned with geometric squiggle blocks
High-contrast color pop (orange/mint) against muted earth tones
Juxtaposition of organic stone texture and rigid rectangular framing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Rectangular photo occupies the bottom-left quadrant, roughly 60% of the height and 70% of the width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central portrait of the two men acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the portrait, moves diagonally up-right to the tilted text and neon patterns.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark marble texture provides significant negative space on the top and right edges.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark forest green and charcoal (marble background)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant mint green and muted coral/orange (graphics and text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the photo and background, high saturation in the graphic overlays for maximum pop.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary blues or reds
Keep the marble dark and moody

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for all display text to maintain 80s minimalist-bold aesthetic.
graphicDevices: Rectangular blocks of mint green 'worm' or 'squiggle' patterns

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and flat-terminal look of the era.
Provides the necessary verticality and weight variations.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark green and black marble texture background. Inset a rectangular sepia-toned photograph of two men in 80s clothing (leather jacket, tank top) in the bottom left. Add two rectangular blocks of mint green 'squiggle' patterns in the top right area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of uppercase, extra-condensed sans-serif text in the space between the mint green blocks, tilted 15 degrees clockwise. Use a coral-orange color for the top line and a cream color for the bottom line.

verificationChecks: Is the marble texture dark and high-contrast?
Is the photo sepia-toned and rectangular?
Is the text tilted and extra-condensed?
Are the mint green squiggle blocks present?

adjustableVariables: Marble color (e.g., dark blue instead of green)
Accent pattern shape (e.g., triangles instead of squiggles)
Photo tint (e.g., cyanotype instead of sepia)
mustRedesign: Any specific faces from the original image

mustAchieve: Sharp contrast between background and accents
avoid: Rounded corners on the photo frame

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the inset photo.
Verify the marble texture looks like stone, not liquid.
Check that the mint green pattern is vibrant and 'neon'.
Confirm the typography is strictly uppercase and condensed.
recipe.reuseFormula: Dark stone texture + Inset sepia photo + Tilted condensed sans-serif + Neon geometric accents = 80s Pop Aesthetic.
